note: P4114 (Pro 19:17) — whoever is generous to the poor lends to the LORD, and he will repay him. (dal 'poor' = standalone.)

dims.v: graciousness — kindness to the poor, a loan to the LORD
the gracious generosity to the poor that is reckoned as lending to the LORD himself, who will repay
the kindness to the poor that God himself takes as a loan

chanan (be gracious/show favour) — 'whoever is GENEROUS to the poor lends to the LORD, and he will repay'; the astonishing word — kindness to the poor is a loan to God, who repays it. Mercy to the needy is credited to God's own account (cf 14:31; 22:9). Generosity as faith in God's repayment.
